name: Thailand (Royal Flag of King Rama X)

colors.symbolism: the royal colour, and the colour of Monday, the King's birthday

description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the royal cypher of King Vajiralongkorn (Rama X): a radiant royal crown above the intertwined monogram ว.ป.ร. outlined in gold with light-blue accents.
history: The personal flag of King Maha Vajiralongkorn, in use since his accession in 2016. Yellow is the King's birthday colour (Monday) and the traditional royal colour of Thailand.

features.role: royal cypher of King Rama X beneath a radiant crown
